scope: Frozen development comparison of approximate first-floor-vicinity candidate timing and object-center localization; no independent physical-contact or IN/OUT accuracy claim.

reference_policy.labels: Frozen AI visual approximate first-vicinity object centers and intervals, not independent human ground truth.
reference_policy.matching: Frozen per-reference coordinate scaling, interval, pixel tolerance and extra frame tolerance; both time and space must pass.
reference_policy.groups: Keep filename A/B groups and identical source SHA groups together; same filename number does not establish rally identity or time synchronization. Counts are video counts, not independent rallies. B17/B18 is a known exact content duplicate.
reference_policy.reserved_evaluation: Separate post-freeze protocol and denominator in reserved_validation; never pooled with primary17.

fresh_full_validation.scope: Selected completed integration subset only; does not claim all 34 accepted cases were freshly rerun.

reserved_validation.scope: Current-round reserved source-only AI first-landing-vicinity check, released only after accepted engine/configuration freeze. Four videos, one scorable approximate object-centre reference and three ambiguous exclusions. All repository clips have previous AI annotations; this is not independent human ground truth or globally unseen data, and it does not measure physical cork contact or IN/OUT accuracy.
reserved_validation.interpretation: No demonstrated improvement on the one scorable reserved reference: both engines miss it. Three ambiguous references remain excluded. This small source-only AI check does not establish independent human/contact/IN-OUT accuracy or globally unseen generalization.

execution_notes: Baseline uses the full original-video pipeline for all 34 inputs. Other complete-cohort phases replay from hash-bound baseline detector/tracker/calibration outputs.
Recovery variants freshly measure native source pixels before events, identity, native contact and decision. Native recovery observations are additional tracks, not detector-stage detections.

Replay may reuse exact read-only analysis-frame cache pixels bound to original source, preprocessing, dimensions and timestamps. Native recovery/contact still reads original-resolution video. Replay timing is not whole-pipeline timing.
v4 raw recovery failed on uhd4k-4-b in both phases; successful scores cover 33 inputs. That reference is unscorable, but the analysis failure remains explicitly reported.
All retained decisions remain REVIEW because first physical contact, target identity and calibration are not established. Candidate agreement is not a legal line call.
Comparison verification re-scores hash-verified results with the frozen scorer and verifies reference bytes; --verify-sources additionally rehashes original video files.
